title: 분식집에서: 덜 맵게, 오이 빼 주세요
objective: Use 덜/안 맵게 해 주세요 and (Noun) 빼 주세요.
summary: Ask for less spicy food and leave out an ingredient at a Korean restaurant.
setting: A small Korean snack restaurant (분식집). The customer orders at the counter and asks to change two things.

task.title: Order food your way
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, fill in, put in order, or answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: Today is less cold than yesterday.

words.example: 아이 거는 안 맵게 해 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Please make the child's one not spicy.
Please leave the green onion out of mine.

dialogue.meaning: Welcome. What can I get you?

dialogue.korean: 떡볶이 하나하고 김밥 한 줄 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: One tteokbokki and one roll of kimbap, please.
The tteokbokki is a bit spicy. Is that OK?

dialogue.korean: 아, 저는 매운 거 잘 못 먹어요. 덜 맵게 해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I can't really eat spicy food. Please make it less spicy.
And please leave the cucumber out of the kimbap.
OK, I'll give it to you without cucumber.

exercises: Choose the right word: 라면을 (덜 / 빼) 맵게 해 주세요.
Fill in the blank with the right form of 빼다 (버섯 = mushrooms): 비빔밥에 버섯은 ____ 주세요.
Put the words in order (양파 = onion): 주세요 / 햄버거에 / 빼 / 양파는
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: What does the customer ask to leave out of the 김밥?
Answer in Korean: Your 닭갈비 is going to be spicy. Tell the server you can't really eat spicy food, then ask for it not spicy. (More than one answer is possible, for example asking for it less spicy.)
answers: 저는 매운 거 잘 못 먹어요. 안 맵게 해 주세요. (또는 덜 맵게 해 주세요.)
